title: Temple Theme Kit inner pages, group B: Membership and Gatherings as TempleKitInner blocks
detail: Two block types (TempleKitInnerTiers with a Monthly or Yearly switch, TempleKitInnerGatherings), one scoped sheet (components/sites/temple-kit-inner/inner-b-css.ts, tokens only) and two page builders (components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages-b.ts) for the design's Membership and Gatherings pages. Gatherings draws the Space's upcoming events and falls back to cards typed in the editor; no member or seat counts are seeded. The design's Online or In person filter is parked: an event row carries no online flag yet. Registration (block map, the sheet into the skin, the pages into the kit) belongs to the Temple kit registration pass. Group C onward follows under LIVE-1686 to 1689.

verify.evidence: temple-kit-inner-b.tsx exports the Tiers and Gatherings blocks.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/page-editor/blocks/temple-kit-inner-b.tsx","utf8");for(const b of ["Tiers","Gatherings"])if(!t.includes("TempleKitInner"+b+":")){console.error("a Temple Kit inner block is missing: "+b);process.exit(1)}'
